response.original_title: How to Dispute a Charge from Marella Cruises: Customer Service & Chargeback Guide
response.overview: To dispute a charge with Marella Cruises  +1-866-254-7549, submit your documentation through the TUI Contact Us Portal or email your ship's billing department (such as finalstatement@marellaexplorer.com) within 28 days of your return  +1-866-254-7549.Before You StartCheck for pending holds: Temporary card authorizations usually disappear from your statement within 14 days.Gather documents: Prepare your booking reference  +1-866-254-7549, sail date, itemized receipts, final statements, and relevant card statements.Steps to Dispute While OnboardVisit Guest Services: Speak with the desk before +1-866-254-7549 disembarking for the quickest resolution.Show physical proof: Bring printed receipts and expense printouts to show the discrepancy.Steps to Dispute After Your TripEmail the ship: Send details and statement copies to the dedicated ship email address (e.g., finalstatement@marellaexplorer.com or finalstatement@marelladiscovery.com).
